metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Node.js simulator at [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js). It runs without third-party dependencies and supports core parsing, expressions, modal state, coordinate systems, linear and arc motion, canned cycles, probing, parameter files, and trace output.

Basic checks passed for syntax, linear trace sampling, G81 timing, parameter evaluation, unit conversion, and JSON output on errors.

**The implementation is incomplete against the full specification.** In particular, cutter compensation geometry is only partial, and some canned-cycle transitions and error trace segment reporting are not fully modeled. It should not be relied on as a complete or machine-accurate G-code simulator.
